items.heading: PLACE TRANSMISSION AT INSTALLATION POSITION, AND INSTALL TRANSMISSION MOUNT BOLTS

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Align the input shaft spline with the clutch disc, and push the transmission fully into position.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Install the two set bolts of the upper transmission, and torque the bolts.

items.heading: INSTALL ENGINE REAR MOUNTING
items.text: Install the eight bolts, and torque them.

items.heading: INSTALL STARTER
items.text: Install the starter, and torque the lower bolt.
